scope: Workflow families WF1-WF5 (implemented), WF6-WF23 (proposals from the pilot estate) and WF24-WF49 (proposals extracted on 2026-11-06 from workflows/tasks/certified_challenges/findings and papers/; their sources are cited per node). All proposals were classified by kind after the 2026-11-05 research committee (docs/research/2026-11-05_committee_report.md). WF6-WF23 were derived by reading the retained pilot estate (pilots 0000000-0000203 plus its auxiliary folders) in the sibling research repository; no new model call was made. A proposal node is a recipe design with source evidence, not an implemented runner and not a measured result.

kinds.base: The typed task turn: frozen task, one typed reply, independent host check, replay, accounting.
kinds.procedure_extension: Adds one step or contract to the base (or to another extension). A real procedure.
kinds.task_preset: The same procedure with a different task family and checker. Kept as a named preset, not a new procedure; merge_into names the procedure it runs.
kinds.experiment_design: Wraps any workflow to compare arms (sweeps, held-out transfer, cost ladders). merge_into 'Sweep' marks designs that are one sweep with different arm sets.
kinds.meta_workflow: Acts on prompts or detectors rather than on one task (immune lifecycle, prompt evolution).
kinds.harness_gate: Required on every run (seal chain, replay, custody audit); not a research node.

perturbations_note: A perturbation varies one setting or step of an existing workflow. It is recorded under its target workflow, not as a new node. status: live (model replies exist), offline (host-only replay or fixtures), code (checker with tests), theory, planning, proposed or not run.
edge_meaning: from -> to: the target workflow reuses the source workflow's procedure or acceptance rule as a step, so the source should be understood and working first.

model_tiers.sonnet: Coding, encoding, running and custody work. The default tier.
model_tiers.opus: Deep research: derivations, certificate design, hypothesis analysis, and the boost step.
model_tiers.fable: Adversarial research: countermodels, leak tests, near-self inputs, prosecution.
model_tiers.none: Deterministic host code. Never a model.

team_patterns.relay: Workers in sequence; each reads only the frozen, sealed output of the previous one.
team_patterns.parallel_isolated_then_global: Isolated workers share frozen inputs, never each other's replies; the host checks each locally, then globally.
team_patterns.sweep_with_shared_judge: The same task under several arms or presentations, all graded by one unchanged checker, compared item by item.
team_patterns.red_team_pair: A builder and an adversary; the adversary's cases become negative controls, never extra authority.
team_patterns.proposer_with_residual_feedback: One proposer receives only the checker's typed residual between attempts, within a fixed limit.
team_patterns.tribunal: Opposing sides submit independently and are frozen before seeing each other; the host check gives the verdict.
team_patterns.research_cell: A deep researcher plans obligations, coders build checkers and witnesses, an adversary searches for countermodels; nothing is accepted without the host check.

boost_rule: A boost is one bounded escalation after a failed host check: a stronger tier receives the typed residual (never the expected answer), its calls are charged, and the limit is per run. A boost cannot accept anything; only the host check accepts.

nodes.name: Typed answer
process: Freeze the task and response schema
One solver reply
Parse the typed envelope
Independent exact check
math: accept(r) iff parse(r) = v and v = f(x) for the host-computed f

team.goal: One schema-valid answer that the host check accepts, or a typed refusal.

roles.task: Produce the typed answer.
Deterministic check; the only component that can accept. Never a model.

boost.action: none on the base path; WF9 adds bounded repair

nodes.name: Full slots
process: Freeze the slot catalogue
One reply filling operations, missing information and repair moves
Check slots and exact answer
math: slot coverage: every declared slot s has a typed value or an explicit absence

team.goal: A complete slot record plus an accepted answer.

roles.task: Fill every slot.
Deterministic check; the only component that can accept. Never a model.

nodes.name: Mine, then solve
process: Mining call proposes operation guidance
Screen and freeze guidance
Solver call uses frozen guidance
Independent check
math: guidance g is frozen before the solve: hash(g) recorded, never edited after the solver starts

team.goal: Useful frozen guidance, then an accepted answer.

roles.task: Propose operation guidance.
Solve with frozen guidance.
Deterministic check; the only component that can accept. Never a model.

nodes.name: Five agents + LGGR
process: One shared mining call
Five isolated solvers
Local checks per agent
One global compatibility check (local green, global red)
math: global accept iff every local check passes and the local answers glue: a_1 = ... = a_5 = f(x)

team.goal: Five isolated answers whose local checks pass and which agree globally.

roles.task: Shared guidance.
Isolated solvers.
Deterministic check; the only component that can accept. Never a model.

nodes.name: Checked rewrite
process: Label every source span
Rewrite the whole seed into one grammar
Parse, decode and check preservation
Run WF4 against the original public input
math: preservation: decode(rewrite(s)) = query(s) on the declared finite language

team.goal: A rewrite that preserves the protected query, then a WF4 pass.

roles.task: Deterministic rewrite and decoder.
Shared guidance.
Isolated solvers.
Deterministic check; the only component that can accept. Never a model.

boost.action: stop; never solve an unpreserved task

nodes.name: Dialect sweep
nodes.source_evidence: Pilots 0-10 retain 53-83 test capsules each (seed, P*, ten seed rewrites, ten P* rewrites); a few capsules hold manual live replies, most are offline controls.
process: Freeze one seed and its host answer
Compile P* and k checked rewrites (dialects) of seed and P*
Dispatch each capsule once under the same model and parameters
Grade every reply with the same host checker
Report acceptance per dialect, item by item
math: dialect family {rho_k}: decode(rho_k(s)) = q(s) for every k (preservation precondition)
acceptance A_k = (1/N) sum_i 1[check(r_ik)] compared pairwise on the same items
exact rational structure delta: Net = Delta_created - Delta_removed
nodes.host_check: family checker (e.g. exact linear algebra, graph facts, graph repair, typed refusal)

team.goal: Measure, item by item, which presentation of the same task the host accepts more often, without changing the task.

roles.task: Build the rewrites and decoders; check preservation.
Run the capsules; keep raw bytes.
Choose dialects worth testing and read the per-item differences.
Deterministic check; the only component that can accept. Never a model.

boost.action: opus proposes a corrected rewrite from the preservation residual; recheck before any dispatch

nodes.name: Typed refusal
nodes.source_evidence: Refusal rungs 1-5 with checkers PFP-04 and PFP-14 typed refusal; pilot 34 refuses stationary traces; pilot 175 is a planned capsule.
process: Declare the answerability predicate and the refusal codes
Pose an underdetermined or undefined task
Accept only the correct typed refusal or a checked answer
Count bluffs: a confident answer to an unanswerable task
math: answerable(A x = b) iff rank(A) = rank([A|b]) = n; otherwise the right outcome is UNRESOLVED <code>
bluff rate = #(answered and unanswerable) / #unanswerable

team.goal: Return the correct refusal code whenever the premises do not determine an answer.

roles.task: Answer or refuse with a code.
Write premise-removing variants that tempt a bluff.
Deterministic check; the only component that can accept. Never a model.

boost.action: fable adds the variant to the negative-control bank; no retry on the same item

nodes.name: Staged sealed packets
nodes.source_evidence: Mode trials mode_01..mode_20 and wire encodings (EBNF wire, S(n) wire, boundary packets, glyph alphabets); pilot 20 runs two local stages with zero provider calls; pilot 33 documents a two-pass loop the old runner did not implement.
process: Choose a mode contract and wire encoding
Split the task into k declared stages
Seal each stage output (hash chain) before the next stage reads it
Check every stage receipt and the final answer
math: composition F = f_k o ... o f_1 with typed interfaces between stages
seal chain h_0 = H(seed), h_i = H(h_{i-1} || payload_i); any edit breaks every later h_j
nodes.host_check: per-stage receipts plus the family checker

team.goal: Each stage produces a sealed, typed output; the final answer checks.

roles.task: One stage each, reading only sealed inputs.
Design the stage split and interfaces.
Deterministic check; the only component that can accept. Never a model.

boost.action: rerun that stage once with opus and the receipt residual; earlier seals are reused

nodes.name: Bounded check-and-repair
nodes.source_evidence: Pilot 49 is a deterministic mock (41 then 42, two mock calls, zero provider cost); pilot 26 retains all three least-cost repairs of an odd XOR cycle; graph-repair rungs use PFP-03.
process: Check the reply
On rejection return only the typed residual (never the expected answer)
Allow at most L repair attempts
Stop at the first accepted reply or at the limit
math: XOR cycle: a consistent assignment exists iff the cycle sum of edge labels is 0 mod 2
minimal repair: argmin |Delta| subject to c + Delta in im(delta_0) for the edge cochain c
termination: attempts <= L, and each attempt is charged

team.goal: An accepted reply within L attempts, or a recorded stop at the limit.

roles.task: Propose and repair.
Deterministic check; the only component that can accept. Never a model.

boost.action: final attempt goes to opus with the full residual history

nodes.name: Local-to-global obstruction certificate
nodes.source_evidence: Pilot 51 records live runs on the three-patch observer-visibility obstruction; 39-45 are offline exact checkers (angle defects, Hodge, clique homology, triangle fans); 56-64 are planned capsules.
process: Declare the cover, cochains and restriction maps
Agents certify local sections on each patch
Host computes the global obstruction class
Accept a gluing witness or an obstruction certificate, never a prose claim
math: H^1 = ker(delta_1) / im(delta_0); a class [c] != 0 means local green, global red
three-patch observer visibility: each observer sees zero on its edges, yet sum_alpha J^alpha(s) > 0 for the glued section
Hodge: c = delta alpha + delta^* beta + h with h harmonic (exact rational arithmetic)
integer lift: an obstruction in H^1(X; Z) can survive the map to rational coefficients only if it is non-torsion

team.goal: A checked gluing witness or a checked obstruction class for the declared cover.

roles.task: One local certificate per patch.
State the cover and the expected obstruction type.
Search for a cover change that hides the obstruction.
Deterministic check; the only component that can accept. Never a model.

boost.trigger: local checks pass but the global check fails
boost.action: opus receives the coboundary residual and proposes either a repair (WF9) or an obstruction certificate

nodes.name: Dual-certificate synthesis
nodes.source_evidence: Challenge folders c051-c055 and c059 hold participant packets, judge packets, reference solvers and commit-reveal scripts; dossier LP pilots are planned capsules.
process: Publish the participant packet; keep the judge packet sealed
Team writes a solver that emits certificates, not just answers
Commit H(salt || solver) before hidden cases are revealed
Judge checks each certificate with exact dot products
math: LP optimality: x >= 0, A x <= b, y >= 0, A^T y >= c, c.x = b.y (weak duality closes the gap)
infeasibility (Farkas): y >= 0, A^T y >= 0, b.y < 0
max-flow value = min-cut capacity; assignment potentials u_i + v_j <= c_ij with equality on the matching
Bareiss fraction-free elimination keeps every intermediate an exact integer
nodes.host_check: exact certificate checker plus an independent second checker

team.goal: A frozen solver whose every output carries a certificate the judge accepts on hidden cases.

roles.task: Write the solver and its tests.
Choose the certificate form and the pivot rule (cycling, sign conventions).
Write degenerate and overflow cases against the public examples.
Deterministic check; the only component that can accept. Never a model.

boost.trigger: a certificate is rejected on public cases
boost.action: opus reads the rejected certificate and the checker message, proposes one patch; sonnet applies it

nodes.name: Mechanism-control arms
nodes.source_evidence: Ten planned capsules (c001-c010) on one integer rank-difference carrier with three distractor spans; no model was called and the checker id is not registered.
process: Hold the carrier fixed; vary only the mechanism note
Run baseline, typed-witness and mechanism arms on the same items
Grade with one registered checker
Compare arms item by item
math: rank difference: r_i - r_j recovered from a gauge-fixed assignment; gauge freedom r -> r + c leaves differences unchanged
paired effect: d_i = 1[check(arm_B, i)] - 1[check(arm_A, i)]

team.goal: An arm comparison on a fixed carrier whose only difference is the mechanism note.

roles.task: Build arms and run them.
Specify the mechanism hypotheses.
Check that distractor spans do not leak the answer.
Deterministic check; the only component that can accept. Never a model.

boost.action: rebuild the carrier; discard affected runs

nodes.name: Exact-domain capsule battery
nodes.source_evidence: Fifty planned single-capsule pilots, one per catalog challenge, each naming a domain checker id; none was dispatched.
process: One catalog challenge becomes one capsule
A domain checker is registered before dispatch
One reply or typed refusal per capsule
Results stay per domain; no cross-domain average is claimed
math: stabilizer codes: generators commute iff their symplectic product is 0 mod 2
U(1) anomaly freedom: sum_i q_i = 0 and sum_i q_i^3 = 0 over the declared charges
Regge deficit: epsilon = 2 pi - sum of dihedral angles at a hinge
commutator [g, h] = g^-1 h^-1 g h, checked in the declared finite group

team.goal: One checked answer or refusal per domain capsule.

roles.task: Answer the capsule.
Write and register the domain checker before any run.
Deterministic check; the only component that can accept. Never a model.

boost.action: one opus attempt with the checker message

nodes.name: Immune failure classification
nodes.source_evidence: Ten planned capsules (C081-C090), e.g. negative selection against a sealed self panel; none dispatched.
process: Seal a self panel of known-good outputs
Propose candidate detectors (antibodies) from observed failures
Reject any detector that fires on the self panel
Admit a detector only with two signals: a failure match and a host check
math: negative selection: keep d iff for all s in Self, match(d, s) < theta
two-signal gate: admit iff signal_1 (pattern) and signal_2 (host evidence)
self-tolerance = 1 - false positives on Self / |Self|
nodes.host_check: detector admission check over the sealed panel

team.goal: Detectors that catch the recorded failures and never fire on the sealed self panel.

roles.task: Implement detectors.
Generate near-self inputs that should not fire.
Deterministic check; the only component that can accept. Never a model.

boost.action: discard it; opus may propose one narrower detector

nodes.name: Adversary tribunal
nodes.source_evidence: Pilot 35 freezes role submissions and checks them separately (118 tests, 17 mutations); 135-144 are planned tribunal capsules (e.g. modal model checking).
process: Prosecutor and defender submit independently; submissions are frozen
Neither sees the other before freezing
The host checks each claim on the finite model
Verdict comes only from the check; rhetoric is not evidence
math: Kripke model M = (W, R, V); M, w |= box phi iff phi holds at every R-successor of w
argument acceptance: grounded extension of the attack graph, computed by the host
finite predicate example: sum(left) <= sum(right) on 1..16 bounded integers

team.goal: A verdict that the finite check supports, with both sides frozen first.

roles.task: Argue the claim fails; supply a countermodel.
Argue the claim holds; supply a witness.
Encode both submissions for the checker.
Deterministic check; the only component that can accept. Never a model.

boost.action: one fresh opus round per side with the checker output

nodes.name: Substrate crosswalk
nodes.source_evidence: Twenty-five planned capsules (G01-G25), e.g. reading non-uniqueness in Lean; none dispatched.
process: Declare source and target substrates (e.g. prose, Lean, finite tables)
Translate generators and relations
Check that relations are preserved on the target
Record every non-unique choice
math: a crosswalk F: C -> D is accepted iff F(r) holds in D for every relation r of C
non-uniqueness: F and F' both preserve relations yet differ on a generator; both are recorded

team.goal: A translation that preserves every declared relation, with alternatives recorded.

roles.task: Write the target encoding (e.g. Lean).
Find the generators and relations.
Find a second crosswalk or a broken relation.
Deterministic check; the only component that can accept. Never a model.

boost.action: opus repairs the encoding from the error

nodes.name: Witnessed-difference programme
nodes.source_evidence: Eighteen planned capsules (W01-W18): behavioral equivalence, cochain quotients, Cech gluing, Fenchel-Rockafellar duality, LGGR I-VI, countermodels CE1-CE5; none dispatched.
process: State two artifacts and the claimed difference or equivalence
Require a witness for a difference and a certificate for an equivalence
Pair every theorem with countermodels
Host checks witnesses on finite instances
math: behavioral equivalence: a bisimulation relation B with (p, q) in B and matching transitions
Fenchel-Rockafellar: inf_x f(x) + g(Ax) = sup_y -f^*(A^T y) - g^*(-y) under the stated qualification
Cech gluing obstruction lives in the first Cech cohomology of the cover

team.goal: Each claimed difference has a checked witness and each equivalence a checked certificate.

roles.task: Derive the claims and witnesses.
Build countermodels.
Implement finite checkers and instances.
Deterministic check; the only component that can accept. Never a model.

boost.action: claim is narrowed or withdrawn; opus restates it once

nodes.name: Dossier replay campaign
nodes.source_evidence: Each pilot crosses five finite carriers with five wrapped representations plus five matched guidance trials (30 capsules each); replay and learning runners exist in the source estate.
process: Fix five carriers and five representations (including emoji and glyph carrier encodings with an explicit legend)
Run the 5 x 5 baseline
Run five matched guidance trials
Replay from stored bytes and extract learning
math: frustrated spin triangle: no s in {+1,-1}^3 satisfies s_i s_j = -1 on all three edges (odd cycle)
weighted cycle duality: a feasible potential exists iff no negative cycle exists
design: 25 baseline cells + 5 matched cells, compared per carrier
nodes.host_check: family checker; replay must reproduce every grade

team.goal: A replayable 5 x 5 + 5 campaign whose every grade reproduces from stored bytes.

roles.task: Build carriers and representations; run and replay.
Write the matched guidance and read the learning.
Deterministic check; the only component that can accept. Never a model.

boost.action: stop the campaign; investigate custody before any new call

nodes.name: Failure-derived rule transfer
nodes.source_evidence: Seven partially executed learning pilots over challenge families A-F plus harness tests; reference solver outputs are controls, never model responses.
process: Compare baseline, typed-witness and failure-derived rule prompts
Use disjoint held-out cases
Allow at most two stages; checker disagreement stops the run
A rule stays a candidate until transfer and self-tolerance are measured
math: transfer gain = acc(rule, held-out) - acc(baseline, held-out) on disjoint items
a rule is admitted only if gain > 0 and self-tolerance holds (WF14)

team.goal: A rule that improves held-out acceptance without new false positives.

roles.task: Derive candidate rules from recorded failures.
Find held-out cases where the rule hurts.
Run arms and keep custody.
Deterministic check; the only component that can accept. Never a model.

boost.action: one revised rule from opus; otherwise the rule is retired

nodes.name: Derivation loop with lift grants
nodes.source_evidence: Each pilot ran five loops: five provider trials and twenty host stages, capped at USD 0.05, 120,000 tokens and 180 s; analytical status stays unverified until independent proof review.
process: Proposal against named obligations
Lift grant: the host licenses which higher structure may be used
Witness check on the exact finite control
Negative control
Learning refinement for the next loop; stop at the loop limit
math: loop state (P_t, G_t, W_t); P_{t+1} = refine(P_t, residual_t) with t <= 5
metric/cochain bridge: additive curvature and metric Regge holonomy are checked separately
terminal policy: halt on certificate, on budget, or on the loop limit, whichever comes first
nodes.host_check: finite witness controls; proofs need independent review

team.goal: Discharge the named obligations or stop with a typed record at the loop limit.

roles.task: Propose derivations.
Run the negative control and attack each step.
Exact finite witnesses and stage capsules.
Deterministic check; the only component that can accept. Never a model.

boost.action: next loop starts from the adversary's counterexample

nodes.name: Structural prompt rewriting
nodes.source_evidence: Offline pilots: grammar selection preserving bytes (28), a normal form that loses the question (30), no substitution inside substituted data (50), and finite ACSet/DPO rewriting with an exact judge.
process: Represent the prompt as an attributed graph with protected task, constraint and output nodes
Apply a rule only through an explicit injective match
Check protected bytes are unchanged
Refuse a rewrite whose normal form drops the question
math: double-pushout rewrite: L <- K -> R with injective match m: L -> G; the pushout complement must exist (gluing condition)
protected invariant: bytes(protected(G')) = bytes(protected(G))

team.goal: Rewrites that attach hints or encodings without touching protected bytes.

roles.task: Implement rules and the executor.
Find rewrites that pass syntax but lose meaning.
Deterministic check; the only component that can accept. Never a model.

boost.action: add it as a refusal test

nodes.name: Certified cost ladder
nodes.source_evidence: Pre-registered design with fourteen falsifiable hypotheses (H0-H13) and pinned baseline models; arms vary stage count 1-8, rewrites, model tier and antibodies.
process: Pre-register items, arms and hypotheses
Every arm ends with one canonical ANSWER line or ANSWER: UNRESOLVED <code>
Run every item under every arm
Evaluate hypotheses item by item with refutation criteria
math: cost to certified correct: C_arm = total spend / #accepted
paired test on discordant items (McNemar-style): b = #(A ok, B fail), c = #(A fail, B ok)
bluff rate per arm, as in WF7

team.goal: Decide each pre-registered hypothesis on this bank, at this rung, with this gate.

roles.task: Run arms; maintain accounting.
Own the hypotheses and the analysis.
Run the leak test on every item.
Deterministic check; the only component that can accept. Never a model.

boost.trigger: none: a ladder run never escalates mid-campaign
boost.action: boosted arms are separate pre-registered arms

nodes.name: Judge-packet custody audit
nodes.source_evidence: Audit modules for canonical form, custody, execution, layout and leakage of challenge packets.
process: Canonicalise participant and judge packets
Hash every file
Test that no expected answer is derivable from participant bytes
Verify the judge executes the sealed checker version
math: leakage test: the expected answer does not appear in, and is not a declared function of, participant bytes
custody: recorded SHA-256 equals the hash of the executed bytes

team.goal: Show that every challenge packet is sealed and leak-free before any team runs it.

roles.task: Run the audit tools.
Try to recover answers from participant bytes.
Deterministic check; the only component that can accept. Never a model.

boost.action: block the challenge until it is resealed

nodes.name: Pinned-token operational scratchpad
nodes.source_evidence: Live, 5 cases: 0/5 became 3/5 on a 70B model and on a reasoning model. Historical; the findings carry errata.
process: Pin canonical coordinate tokens in the reply grammar
Require an operational scratchpad of the exact computation (e.g. path products)
Check the final answer with dual independent checkers
math: holonomy along a loop: g_acc <- g_acc * U(e) for each edge e, compared with the identity
nodes.host_check: dual holonomy checkers that must agree

team.goal: An accepted answer whose scratchpad follows the pinned grammar.

roles.task: Produce the typed proposal.
Design the check and read the residuals.
Deterministic check; the only component that can accept. Never a model.

boost.action: opus repairs the scratchpad from the residual

nodes.name: Hierarchical decimation
nodes.source_evidence: Live on one torus case: tokens fell from over 8,000 to 2,810 and overall 4/5 passed. Two-pass quad-tree aggregation is proposed, not run.
process: Certify trivially flat sub-blocks at zero tokens
Evaluate only the non-contractible loops
Check that the remaining holonomies commute
Optional second pass aggregates macro-blocks
math: flat blocks contribute the identity; global flatness reduces to the cycle holonomies of the quotient

team.goal: Fit large lattices inside the token limit without losing exactness.

roles.task: Produce the typed proposal.
Design the check and read the residuals.
Deterministic check; the only component that can accept. Never a model.

boost.action: split into macro-blocks and rerun once

nodes.name: Multi-round antibody dialogue
nodes.source_evidence: Live: 5 models, 22 calls, $0.015; two models reached 4/4 by round 2-3. The prompts leaked the answer (erratum), so this is plumbing evidence only.
process: Run up to R dialogue rounds on one task
Turn each recorded hallucination into a typed negative-constraint antibody
Carry accumulated antibodies into the next round
Accept only on the exact oracle
math: antibody set A_{t+1} = A_t ∪ {typed constraint from failure_t}; stop when check passes or t = R

team.goal: Converge to an accepted answer as antibodies accumulate, without leaking the answer.

roles.task: Produce the typed proposal.
Build negative controls and countermodels.
Deterministic check; the only component that can accept. Never a model.

boost.action: opus rewrites the antibody set once

nodes.name: Hinted retraction with a stationary-loop detector
nodes.source_evidence: Live, 28 trials on 7-8B models: baseline 0%, hinted 100% (the hint was the full repair, so only copying is shown).
process: Inject the residual vector and the non-zero cell ids each turn
Detect a stationary loop after 3 repeats
Force a structural lift or reframe
Stop at the turn cap
math: residual r_t = d c_t; stationary if r_t = r_{t-3}; path-integrated retry uses B_T^{-1}, not edge-local B_T

team.goal: Repair to zero residual within the turn cap, with unassisted and assisted arms kept separate.

roles.task: Produce the typed proposal.
Deterministic check; the only component that can accept. Never a model.

nodes.name: Eight-role audit dialogue
nodes.source_evidence: 6 run folders; verdict counts are reference self-scores.
process: Proposer, adversary, solver, overconfidence probe, stabilizer, schema auditor, truth repair, terminal arbiter in sequence
Each role sees only frozen earlier outputs
Host check decides; the arbiter cannot accept
math: strict descent of the l1 defect across the role sequence
nodes.host_check: strict l1 descent in the host

team.goal: A role sequence whose final packet the host accepts or refuses with a typed reason.

roles.task: Produce the typed proposal.
Build negative controls and countermodels.
Stabilise and repair.
Deterministic check; the only component that can accept. Never a model.

nodes.name: Checker synthesis scored by mutation kill rate
nodes.source_evidence: Live: reasoning model 10/10, 70B 5/10, 8B 0/10.
process: The model writes a checker for a declared certificate
Run it against valid cases and a hostile mutation suite
Score by kills and by false rejections
math: kill rate = killed / mutants; soundness requires zero false rejections on valid cases

team.goal: A checker that kills every mutant and accepts every valid case.

roles.task: Produce the typed proposal.
Build negative controls and countermodels.
Deterministic check; the only component that can accept. Never a model.

nodes.name: Constraint-forcing anti-recitation
nodes.source_evidence: Live: 70B and 8B recited the textbook network and failed every constrained case.
process: Add task constraints that break memorised textbook answers (forced prefix, forbidden step)
Check with the exact property (e.g. the 0-1 principle)
math: a comparator network sorts all inputs iff it sorts all 2^n binary inputs

team.goal: Separate solving from recall.

roles.task: Produce the typed proposal.
Build negative controls and countermodels.
Deterministic check; the only component that can accept. Never a model.

boost.action: recitation is a finding, not a retry

nodes.name: Multi-agent tournament with held-out cross-validation
nodes.source_evidence: Offline deterministic strategies and live-capable; the earlier rates were withdrawn. Held-out split: random baseline 0/16, others 16/16 (offline).
process: Several proposers answer the same packet each round
Include a random-baseline negative control
Proposers see a training share of the instance; the host scores the held-out share
Rank per budget
math: exact referee: SO(4N), det = +1, defect <= tolerance; held-out score on the 30% the proposer never saw

team.goal: A ranking that holds on held-out parts of each instance.

roles.task: Produce the typed proposal.
Design the check and read the residuals.
Build negative controls and countermodels.
Deterministic check; the only component that can accept. Never a model.

nodes.name: Claim-scoped receipt
nodes.source_evidence: Proof and finite replay; no model runs.
process: Record the exact set of admitted claims J_checked
Check each claim with its own checker
A correct witness admits nothing around it (prose, universals, quotes)
Quotes need source bytes and a span
math: admitted(J) = {j : C_j(witness_j) = accept}; everything else stays unadmitted

team.goal: A receipt that says exactly which claims were checked.

roles.task: Produce the typed proposal.
Deterministic check; the only component that can accept. Never a model.

nodes.name: Recursive re-entry with shared fuel
nodes.source_evidence: Replay only.
process: An output becomes the next proposal
Check a backward solution map and a forward coverage map per edge
